write_up: It’s common for accounting resumes to list duties this way. Yours shows a move from Accounts Payable Clerk to Staff Accountant at Rivermark Building Supply, but most of the recent lines stop at the name of the task. A recruiter looking for a staff accountant has little to compare with other resumes.

The purchase order line is your best model: it names the documents you matched, so a reader can picture the work. Your accounting degree and progression are easy to find, but the resume doesn’t say how much work you handle or what your part in the close and audit involves.
Let’s start with month-end close. Name the tasks you handle, then add the types of accounts, schedules and audit materials you work with. Use volumes or results where you can confirm them.
